Warehousing

घनत्व गणना

The process of determining the mass per unit volume of goods or packaging, required for transport documentation, freight class assignment, and compliance with carrier and regulatory rules (e.g., IATA, IMO, freight tariffs).

Quick answer: The process of determining the mass per unit volume of goods or packaging, required for transport documentation, freight class assignment, and compliance with carrier and regulatory rules (e.g., IATA, IMO, freight tariffs).

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

The process of determining the mass per unit volume of goods or packaging, required for transport documentation, freight class assignment, and compliance with carrier and regulatory rules (e.g., IATA, IMO, freight tariffs).

Operational example

Density calculation is mandatory when declaring cargo for air or sea transport according to IATA and IMO standards.
